title: Allied foo fighter investigations with Robertson and Alvarez

tellings.quote: And one of the people that was uh assigned to conduct that study happened to be Dr. Howard Robertson from Caltech

plain: During the Second World War, Allied airmen reported strange lights following their planes, which they called foo fighters, and a study was set up to look into them. Kurt McConnell, a former Senate staffer, says one of the people assigned to that study was Dr. Howard Robertson, a scientist from Caltech, and he also names the physicist Luis Alvarez. He tells it without naming a source, to show that top scientists were looking at these things from the very start.
